trials.claim: Lifetime access to Rhino on 1 Code tier
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Rhino
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes unlimited access as a one-time payment with no subscription, and a buyer confirms it was sold as a lifetime deal rather than a monthly plan.

exhibits.quote: Unlimited: invite 2 friends or pay $20 once. No subscription, no account.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states unlimited access is a one-time payment with no subscription.

exhibits.quote: The fact that it was a lifetime deal and it was a dictation where most of them are on a monthly plan, I thought it was going to be not good at all.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the purchase was sold as a lifetime deal rather than a monthly plan.

trials.claimQuote:
1 Macs per code
- Unlimited entries Personal dictionary
- Unlimited Minutes of dictation
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show the app learns and stores personal names, but neither shows that personal dictionary entries are unlimited.

exhibits.quote: It's fast, it learns your names, and it saves hours of typing.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms the app learns personal names, supporting the personal dictionary feature.

exhibits.quote: In the dictionary, names can be stored as Rhino currently understands them versus how they are actually spelled.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the dictionary stores personal names and spellings as promised.

trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited entries Personal dictionary
- Unlimited Minutes of dictation
- All included Future updates
trials.reasoning: The vendor says a one-time payment gives unlimited use, and a buyer confirms the deal removed the word-count limit.

exhibits.quote: Free (2,000 words a week after a free first week), or $20 once for unlimited
exhibits.argument: The vendor states paying once provides unlimited usage after the free tier.

exhibits.quote: for $5 i wont need to worry about hitting my wordcount limit! So far, it is working - i just use in English, on my Mac, simple tasks.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the deal removes the wordcount limit for dictation.

trials.claim: Every future update to Rhino is included at no extra cost
trials.claimQuote: Yes. Every future update to Rhino is included at no extra cost.
trials.reasoning: The reviews show updates and new features were delivered, but neither shows that every future update is included at no extra cost.

exhibits.quote: I love all the updates and can’t wait for it to meet (or exceed) my expectations.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms updates are being delivered to owners.

exhibits.quote: I suggested a couple features via that link in the app and I kid you not that they were implemented the next day!!!!
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms requested features were implemented the next day at no extra cost.

trials.reasoning: A buyer reports the actual deal price was $5, directly conflicting with the claimed $12 price; the vendor's separate $20 regular price is not counted against a deal price.

exhibits.quote: Unlimited: invite 2 friends or pay $20 once. No subscription, no account.
exhibits.argument: Vendor sells unlimited access for $20 once, undermining the $12 deal price claim.

exhibits.quote: I think the current 2026-10-08 price of $5 is just way too low
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the actual deal price was $5, not $12 as claimed.

trials.claim: AI dictation that types voice into any app, fully on device, Mac only
trials.claimQuote: AI dictation that types your voice into any app, fully on device (Mac only)
trials.reasoning: Despite the vendor's any-app, on-device claims, buyers report it would not work on a 2019 MacBook Pro and failed to insert text after clicking away, materially limiting the any-app Mac claim.

exhibits.quote: Won't work on my 2019 Macbook pro despite having the latest OS.
exhibits.argument: App fails on an Intel Mac, so Mac-only dictation does not work on all Macs.

exhibits.quote: when I finish my dictation nothing will populate because I clicked off the app
exhibits.argument: Dictation fails to insert text when focus changes, contradicting types into any app.

exhibits.quote: Talk instead of typing.Free, and nothing leaves your Mac.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states dictation is fully on-device and Mac-based.

exhibits.quote: Hold one key, say it, let go. Your words show up in any app: email, Slack, docs, ChatGPT.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states voice types directly into any app.

themes.summary: Several users report reliability issues like slow insertion, clipboard overwrite, focus loss, and music not resuming.

hits.quote: it takes 4 seconds for it to drop the text into the block after processing.
the dictated text gets inserted into the field but also replaces the link on my clipboard.
when I finish my dictation nothing will populate because I clicked off the app I am talking to even though the bubble still shows it is recording me.
when I pause my music to start transcribing, the music doesn't automatically resume afterward.

themes.summary: Many buyers say dictation and transcription work fast, accurately and reliably.

hits.quote: This is literally the best app I've tried.
The dictation is perfect, and i love it keeps record of all the dications.
More reliable than Wispr Flow, which often doesn’t paste even when there’s an active cursor in an app.

themes.summary: Buyers repeatedly call it a bargain compared to monthly dictation subscriptions.

hits.quote: Much better than paying for a monthly subscription to Wisprflow.
For 5 dollars, it’s a no-brainer and the transcription is really fast
I was able to cancel my monthly AI transcription subscription, saving my business almost $500 per year.

themes.summary: Intel Mac buyers say the listing hid the Apple Silicon requirement until after redemption.

hits.quote: It doesn't mention that it requires Apple silicon until after you've redeemed your code.
Won't work on my 2019 Macbook pro despite having the latest OS.

themes.summary: One buyer says feature suggestions were implemented the next day.

hits.quote: I suggested a couple features via that link in the app and I kid you not that they were implemented the next day!!!!

themes.summary: Bilingual users say it cannot handle switching languages mid-sentence.

hits.quote: if you are a bilingual person and you switch from English to Spanish in the middle of the sentence
